label: Calm driving
expect: Eyes on the road, normal blinks: the monitor calibrates on this and stays quiet

label: Talking and singing
expect: Chatting and singing along, eyes on the road: no yawn, no alert

label: Repeated yawning
expect: Each yawn is noted, the squint isn't a microsleep. Three yawns flag fatigue (the demo compresses the usual 5-minute window)

label: Microsleep
expect: Eyes stay shut while the head droops: 'Eyes closed' alert after 1.2 s

label: Looking away
expect: Head turns to the side window for more than 2 s: 'Eyes off the road' alert, cleared on return
